verdict.rationale: Publishing statutory fee amounts is a fair question for a state business-filing office, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing bot walls (Akamai 403 and Incapsula interstitials) on www.nvsos.gov and esos.nv.gov/orion.nv.gov, with no content about fee schedules or amounts. Absence of evidence yields none; confidence is low because the pages were unreadable rather than shown to lack fees.

support.subject: As a founder, the exact statutory fees for my transaction are published on the service's own pages — amounts, not a contact form
